verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer Agent is documented to let users "ask any question about your application" and have it "find the right telemetry to answer it," directly matching the natural-language query story, and the Sentry MCP server further enables AI assistants to search errors and analyze performance via natural language. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of chart-generation output and no example showing an actual query/chart result returned.
